description: SOC-thermal model for iron-air secondary batteries with Arrhenius R(T) and entropic heating
source: Trocino et al. (2022) J. Power Sources; Manohar et al. (2012) J. Electrochem. Soc.; Form Energy (2022) techreport

cell.name: Iron-Air (Fe-Air) secondary battery
cell.note: Fe + 1.5 H2O <-> Fe(OH)2 + H2 at anode; O2 reduction at cathode. E^0 ~ 1.28 V

voltage_max.note: OCV for Fe + O2 system in alkaline: ~1.28 V

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref; higher than Zn-air due to Fe electrode kinetics

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial for Fe-air battery in alkaline electrolyte
ocv_coefficients.source: Manohar et al. (2012) J. Electrochem. Soc. 159(8), A1209-A1214; Form Energy 2022
ocv_coefficients.note: OCV ranges from 0.60 V (empty) to ~1.28 V (full). Flatter plateau than Li-ion due to two-phase reaction

E_a.note: Activation energy for Fe-air internal resistance. Higher than Zn-air due to Fe electrode sluggish kinetics. Trocino 2022

alpha_c.note: Capacity-temperature coefficient (similar to other alkaline systems)

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for Fe-air. Positive: Fe electrode slightly exothermic on discharge (entropy increases). Trocino et al. 2022 reports mild endothermic effect -> use +0.0002 V/K

current.note: positive=discharge. Slow kinetics limit rate capability
